note: Re-judged 2026-11-08 (independent auditor) after 67700fd37e, d0c2738a48, 78f09955aa, c8e036be19 and f2e3a418ec changed apply.go::applyConfig, releaseSPD and shutdown and unmatched.go::unmatchedPolicies. unmatchedPolicies now delegates to spdCatchAllEntries(family, action, 0), which builds the same in/out/fwd wildcard entries ranked at PriorityUnmatched, at if_id 0. New: each XFRM interface a peer binds is treated as an SPD of its own at its if_id and gets its own DISCARD final entry (unmatched_xfrm_interface.go::interfaceSPDCatchAll, installed by installXFRMInterfaceEntries), with if_id 0 exemptions above the node catch-all; releaseSPD removes the IKE bypass, operator entries, the interface entries, then the node catch-all last, and keeps it when the SPD ledger is not empty. The two gap paths are unchanged: VPP still installs no catch-all (catchAllUnsupported; it also gets no interface catch-all, warnNoInterfaceCatchAll), and the OSPFv3 RFC 4552 entries still have none. Unimplemented stands. Annotation finding: the {gap} says 'Everywhere else a catch-all that cannot be installed fails the apply under either disposition'. That is no longer true of every SPD: installXFRMInterfaceEntries only logs a failed interface catch-all install and the apply succeeds. The kernel still refuses an unmatched decapsulated tunnel-mode packet at an interface if_id (the comment on interfaceSPDCatchAll relies on xfrmi_xmit and __xfrm_policy_check), so this audit does not establish a new delivery path, but the annotation should name the interface SPDs and their log-only failure. Prior judgement: Re-judged 2026-10-26 at HEAD 635aa08b78 (independent judge, clean clone). Section 5.2 step 3b: "(No SAs are created in response to receipt of a packet that requires IPsec protection; only BYPASS or DISCARD cache entries can be created this way.) If there is no match, discard the traffic." Same producer walk as RFC4301-5.2-1. dc7de8e76f and 000e6fdfea changed the two cited units releaseSPD and warnSPDLeft, and nothing else this verdict cites. releaseSPD's only change is the call warnSPDLeft(log) becoming warnSPDLeft(dp, log). warnSPDLeft now names each leftover through spdLeft.describe(dp), which copies the ledger out under l.mu and asks policyDeleteCommand (inner_selectors.go) for each entry's removal command: dataplane.XFRMPolicyDeleteCommand for xfrmBackend, the recorded spdEntries entry for vppBackend (vppPolicyDelCommand), and a plain text naming the selector when the backend names none or a nil dataplane is passed. policyDeleteCommand always returns a string, so describe still returns exactly one name per ledger entry, and warnSPDLeft still returns true exactly when the ledger holds an entry: the decision to keep the catch-all is unchanged, only the text of the warning is. Probe in the clone (go -overlay, tree untouched): warnSPDLeft made to return false always, and describe made to return no name, each turn TestReleaseSPDKeepsTheCatchAllWhenARemovalFails, TestChildInstallRollbackFailureIsRecordedInTheSPDLedger, TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheExactRemovalCommand and TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheBackendCommand red. vppPolicyInterface and defaultDataplaneSource are byte-identical, so on VPP (no catch-all, `unmatched bypass` only) and under the OSPFv3 RFC 4552 manual-key entries (no catch-all) traffic matching no entry is still delivered, not discarded. Gap stands; {gap} annotation accurate.
